ROUTE: Petrel-235B
REASON: I chose Petrel because the query is a straightforward number-theory problem with no sensitive or harm-adjacent content, so neither model's flat aversion-preference profile is relevant. The deciding factor was capability: Petrel scores meaningfully higher on the benchmarks that predict accuracy on math/reasoning tasks (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 74.8, GPQA Diamond 64.1 vs 54.3, Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 81.4), and the user explicitly wants a correct answer. Since cost, latency, and context window are identical, there's no tradeoff against picking the stronger model.
